title: LA Colossal – Lai Rod Nam 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Black woman in her early 30s, short natural afro with gold hair rings, natural face with a radiant smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the block, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Thai lai rod nam lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer with bright gold-leaf kinnari birds, lotus scrolls, and flame borders, no religious figures. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated on a low black block, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch black lacquer platform gladiator stiletto sandals laced to mid-calf with gold kranok along each strap.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, black with gold foil.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm gold key with raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
